step1_analysis.description: The netlist contains the NMOS core of a transimpedance amplifier. Transistors XM1 and XM3 form the main amplifying stage, while XM8 provides an auxiliary output. Several dummy transistors are tied to ground. In a complete TIA, this core would be combined with feedback resistors and load elements.

paper_reference.title: A Si BiCMOS Transimpedance Amplifier for 10-Gb/s SONET Receiver

Transimpedance Gain.description: Ratio of output voltage to input current, expressed in dB ohms.

sky130_expected.calculation: Assuming Rf=1kΩ and Rload=1kΩ added in testbench: gm ≈ 3mA/V. Open loop gain A = gm*Rload = 3. Closed loop Zt = Rf * A / (1+A) = 750 Ω. In dB: 20*log10(750) = 57.5 dB.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Gain depends heavily on the feedback and load resistors chosen to complete the circuit in the testbench.

Bandwidth.description: Frequency where the transimpedance gain drops by 3 dB from its DC value.

sky130_expected.calculation: Input pole dominates. Cin = 0.1pF (photodiode) + Miller C (~20fF) + Cgs (~16fF) = 136fF. Rin = Rf / (1+A) = 250 Ω. f_3dB = 1 / (2*π*Rin*Cin) ≈ 4.6 GHz.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Without the advanced BiCMOS devices and optimized shunt peaking inductors mentioned in the paper, the bandwidth of this basic NMOS core will be lower than the reported 9 GHz.

Power Consumption.description: Total DC power consumed by the circuit from the supply.

sky130_expected.calculation: Id ≈ 0.83mA for main stage + 0.4mA for auxiliary stage = 1.23mA. Power = 1.8V * 1.23mA = 2.2 mW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: The extracted netlist only contains the NMOS core, so it consumes less power than the full BiCMOS circuit reported in the paper. Note: The paper's extracted '31.6 W' is likely an OCR typo for 31.6 mW.

step3_testbench.description: Testbench to measure transimpedance gain, bandwidth, power consumption, and transient response of the TIA core. Feedback resistor, load resistors, and a photodiode model (current source + capacitor) are added to complete the circuit.
step3_testbench.spice:
* TIA Testbench
.lib "${SKY130_PDK}" tt

.param W_xm1=5u L_xm1=0.5u
.param W_xm2=5u L_xm2=0.5u
.param W_xm3=5u L_xm3=0.5u
.param W_xm4=5u L_xm4=0.5u
.param W_xm5=5u L_xm5=0.5u
.param W_xm6=5u L_xm6=0.5u
.param W_xm7=5u L_xm7=0.5u
.param W_xm8=5u L_xm8=0.5u

* DUT
XM1 N4 N12 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm1} w={W_xm1}
XM2 N2 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm2} w={W_xm2}
XM3 N4 N12 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm3} w={W_xm3}
XM4 N0 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm4} w={W_xm4}
XM5 N11 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm5} w={W_xm5}
XM6 N7 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm6} w={W_xm6}
XM7 N1 GND GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm7} w={W_xm7}
XM8 N3 N12 GND GND sky130_fd_pr__nfet_01v8 l={L_xm8} w={W_xm8}

* Biasing, Loads, and Feedback
VDD VDD GND 1.8
L1 VDD N_L1 0.5n
Rload1 N_L1 N4 1k
Rload2 VDD N3 1k
Rf N4 N12 1k

* Input Source (Photodiode model: 0.1pF cap + 10Gb/s current pulse)
Iin N12 GND DC 0 AC 1u PULSE(0 10u 10p 10p 10p 40p 100p)
Cin N12 GND 0.1p

.control
* DC Operating Point & Power
op
let power = -i(VDD) * 1.8
print power

* AC Analysis for Gain and Bandwidth
ac dec 100 1M 100G
* Zt in dB = 20*log10(Vout/Iin). With Iin=1uA, Zt_dB = vdb(N4) + 120
let zt_db = vdb(N4) + 120
meas ac zt_dc find zt_db at=10M
let zt_3db = zt_dc - 3
meas ac bw when zt_db=zt_3db fall=1

* Transient Analysis for 10Gb/s eye/swing
tran 1p 500p
meas tran vout_max max v(N4)
meas tran vout_min min v(N4)
let vout_swing = vout_max - vout_min
print vout_swing

quit
.endc
